lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns, with density increasing towards the anterior region and clusters becoming larger and more widely spaced towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a geometric grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a high-intensity luminance gradient on the superior side and a pronounced shadow on the inferior side, indicating a structural ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs located within the silhouette of the dorsal fin, primarily concentrated along the lower half and leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, irregular high-luminance anomaly is visible on the upper mid-flank, disrupting the standard spot-and-stripe grid; multiple smaller irregular markings and a possible trailing-edge notch on the pectoral fin are observed.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density constellation of small-diameter, high-luminance spots that are notably more compact than the patterning on the lateral flank.
